direction.camera: Guide attention with faceted glint; use a deliberate hold, a measured approach and a stable payoff.
direction.composition: a miniature object becomes a frame-filling faceted subject; keep one dominant focal hierarchy and legible supporting evidence.
direction.editing: Open with caustic pattern; alternate proof and breathing room, then resolve with velvet field.
direction.lighting: small sharp light; preserve subject contour and separate it from the supporting field.
direction.materials: cut crystal and velvet; actual material appearance comes from approved imagery or a real 3D asset.
direction.sound: Create a restrained rhythm around quiet contrast; place licensed accents on intentional cuts and keep speech clear.
direction.typography: Use faceted glint,caustic pattern,miniature scale,precise sparkle,quiet contrast,velvet field as hierarchy cues; keep display copy short and body copy readable at final delivery size.
